question.text: \(A, B\) are fixed points with coordinates \((0, a)\) and \((0, b)(a > 0, b > 0)\). \(P\) is variable point \((x, 0)\) referred to rectangular axis. If the angle \(\angle \mathrm{APB}\) is maximum, then

solution.text:
Hint : \(\angle A P B=\theta=\cos ^1\left(\frac{x^2+a^2+x^2+b^2-(a-b)^2}{2 \sqrt{x^2+a^2} \sqrt{x^2+b^2}}\right)\)
For Max; \(\frac{\mathrm{d} \theta}{\mathrm{dx}}=0, \mathrm{x}^2=\mathrm{ab}\)
